about: Short Chinese notes shown on the plan cards, and the study/work assumptions the plan engine uses. Every note points (ref) at a hand-checked fact in data/occ_manual/<file>.json (file:path/inside/file); occ_entry.py refuses to build if a ref does not resolve to a fact with a source, or if a number in the note does not appear in the fact it cites. Keys: '@<assessor abbr>' applies to every occupation that assessor covers; a six-digit code adds to that, and 'own': true drops the assessor-level notes. 'study' replaces the default study assumption (years when the person has no bachelor / already has one); 'work' is the paid work an assessment needs before it can be lodged. 'gap' notes state what the official sources do not say, so they carry no number and no ref.
